Based on the research, Lingala is widely spoken in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), and the capital city is Kinshasa.

As of April 2025, according to an article dated April 20, 2025, **Daniel Bumba Lubaki** is the Governor of the City of Kinshasa, who named new administrators for the city's administrations.

**Source:**
*   The information was found in an article titled "Kinshasa : Daniel Bumba nomme de nouveaux administrateurs à la tête des administrations de la ville," which references decrees signed by Daniel Bumba Lubaki, Governor of the City, on April 18, 2025. (page\_3)
